verdict.rationale: x402 with the hosted CDP Facilitator processes payment and transaction data, so retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy question for this kind of service. The evidence pack documents no user-facing data retention settings or deletion mechanism. The Bazaar's automatic removal of listings after 30 days without settlement is an adjacent catalog-hygiene behavior, not user-controlled retention or deletion, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
